findings.description: AWS access and secret access keys are embedded directly in the Lambda function's environment variables. Environment variables are stored in plaintext, visible in the Lambda console, readable via the GetFunctionConfiguration API by anyone with lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration, and exported through any deployed payload or config dump, so the long-lived credentials are effectively disclosed to a wide audience.

The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches. Running on an unmaintained runtime leaves known vulnerabilities in the language runtime unpatched on a function that also holds long-lived credentials.
